post.originalText:
Fable 5.2 made the most jelly-like flower I've ever seen 🌸

Same prompt, one try each: a 3D jelly-like flower you can rotate, with a control panel

• Fable 5.2: brighter, glossier pink, with thinner petals that twist and tilt as it moves

• Opus 5.5: deeper red and a sturdier bloom, but on a few frames the petals twist into a glitch and overall wuality is not that good

Which one would you put on your desk?
